note: The ONLY place a paid-generation or visual-acceptance gate can be cleared. tools/art_gate.py refuses anything whose entry here is not `approved`, and dispatch_plan.py will not emit a brendan_art task without one. Nothing in this file may be written by an agent: an approval is Brendan typing `approved` and a date. Meshy credits are real money.

approvals.what: Accept the five-species proportion review: the landmark ratio table for mouse, mole, squirrel, otter and badger -- skull_top, eye, neck, shoulder, hip, muzzle_projection, tail_length, torso_width and torso_depth, each as permille of crown -- together with the stature verdict those ratios produce beside the 1536 x 3072 u common-access opening, the 640 u table and the 640 u work surface.
in_scope: The 9 landmark ratios per species (45 values) carried in proportion_comparison_manifest.json, every one of which is still landmark_status PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW.
Which landmark sets the crown: ears for mouse and squirrel, skull for mole, otter and badger.
Whether the five statures read correctly against each other and against the shared props.
not_in_scope: The five height anchors. DEC-039 already approved 1024/922/1178/1526/2611 u; this gate does not reopen them.

Anatomy, silhouette, fur, clothing or any modelling judgement. Decision 0082 is explicit that the comparison bodies are hand-authored box volumes, so approving it approves proportions and not modelling. Per-species construction sheets remain separate deliverables.

640 u as a universal work-contact policy. The manifest marks it EXPLICIT_CANDIDATE_NOT_A_UNIVERSAL_WORK_CONTACT_POLICY and the captures show it sits below the otter's 700 mm and the badger's 1198 mm hip.
Doorway clearance qualification. The manifest marks the opening AUTHORING_BRIEF_NOT_A_CLEARANCE_QUALIFICATION; MOVE-G01 measures clearance separately.

review_captures: elevation_front.png -- 3200x800 orthogonal, all five species in the same doorway. The primary sheet.
evidence.other_captures: The 40 m and 120 m orbits answer whether the sheet reads at RTS camera distance. The figures are a few pixels tall and are not proportion evidence.
evidence.verified: 2026-09-23: all six capture sha256 match the manifest, and the elevation was measured at literal pixel offsets against the declared millimetres -- mouse 1001 vs 1000, mole 903 vs 900, squirrel 1155 vs 1150, otter 1491 vs 1490, badger 2555 vs 2550, opening 3003 vs 3000. One pixel is 7 mm at 142.857 px/m, so every figure is within a pixel. The render is a truthful picture of the declared numbers.
evidence.known_artefact: elevation_front.png clips a 5-pixel sliver of a sixth object at its right edge. Cosmetic; it touches no measurement.

approvals.why_gated: Decision 0002 requires a visual comparison before bulk proportions are approved, and forbids bulk creature generation until they are. The comparison scene was built and captured under decision 0082 on 2026-09-11, so what remains is the human verdict on it. No test asserts whether a set of ratios looks right.
approvals.rescope_reason: The entry previously asked for approval to author and render the comparison scene. That work was committed on 2026-09-11, so the entry was asking permission for work already done while the decision actually waiting on Brendan -- accept these landmark ratios -- was written down nowhere. Only the descriptive fields changed; status, decided and decided_by are untouched.

approvals.what: Generate the remaining creature body models through Meshy once proportions are approved.
approvals.estimate_note: 120 credits for the four founding-species source models (mouse keeper, mole worker, squirrel resident, otter resident) at 30 each: image-to-3D, meshy-7, Ultra off, 2K PBR. Ceiling 150 with one 30-credit replacement attempt for a single failed species. FIRST TRANCHE IS 30 -- the mouse alone -- and the remaining three are a separate decision after its anatomy, material, rig, LOD, bake and gameplay-camera review. Badger is not in this batch. Itemised in docs/planning/creature_generation_batch.md; recording an estimate is not approval and does not authorise the call.
approvals.why_gated: Real money, and decision 0002 forbids bulk generation before proportion approval.

approvals.what: Visual acceptance of the refined HUD. Astra requests further NARROW-breakpoint evidence before it will sign off.
approvals.why_gated: Visual acceptance is a human judgement about whether it looks right. No test asserts taste.
